## <span class="pointer-fine:flex-1 z-1 justify-self-start max-w-full break-words page-cover-background:text-contrast-cover text-start self-start justify-start leading-tight" cover-aware-text="">Snyk Vulnerability Database</span><span class="hash inline-grid grid-area-1-1 pointer-fine:h-[1em] border-0 opacity-0 pointer-events-none site-background rounded transition-opacity pointer-fine:pointer-events-auto pointer-fine:group-hover/hash:opacity-100 pointer-fine:group-focus-within/hash:opacity-100 [.hash-revealed_&]:opacity-100 [.hash-revealed_&]:pointer-events-auto absolute [transform:translateY(0.125em)] pointer-fine:-ml-6 pointer-fine:relative pointer-fine:order-first pointer-fine:self-center pointer-fine:pr-2 pointer-fine:[transform:none] pointer-fine:[.flip-heading-hash_&]:order-last pointer-fine:[.flip-heading-hash_&]:ml-1 pointer-fine:[.flip-heading-hash_&]:pl-2"><a href="#snyk-vulnerability-database" class="inline-flex items-center p-1 pointer-fine:h-full pointer-fine:p-0 leading-tight" aria-label="Direct link to heading"><img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," class="gb-icon self-center transition-colors text-transparent pointer-fine:group-hover/hash:text-tint-subtle contrast-more:pointer-fine:group-hover/hash:text-tint-strong pointer-fine:group-focus-within/hash:text-tint-subtle contrast-more:pointer-fine:group-focus-within/hash:text-tint-strong [.hash-revealed_&amp;]:text-tint-subtle contrast-more:[.hash-revealed_&amp;]:text-tint-strong size-4" /></a></span>

The <span id="base-ui-_R_3s3l59bsnqj6iv5ubsnpfivb_"><a href="https://security.snyk.io" class="underline decoration-[max(0.07em,1px)] underline-offset-2 links-accent:underline-offset-4 links-default:decoration-primary/6 links-default:text-primary-subtle hover:links-default:text-primary-strong contrast-more:links-default:text-primary contrast-more:hover:links-default:text-primary-strong links-accent:decoration-primary-subtle hover:links-accent:decoration-[3px] hover:links-accent:[text-decoration-skip-ink:none] transition-all duration-100">Snyk Vulnerability Database<img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," class="gb-icon ml-0.5 inline size-3 links-accent:text-tint-subtle" /></a></span> contains a comprehensive list of known security vulnerabilities. This provides the key security information used by Snyk products to find and fix code vulnerabilities.

You can inspect the database at <span id="base-ui-_R_3s4l59bsnqj6iv5ubsnpfivb_"><a href="https://security.snyk.io/" class="underline decoration-[max(0.07em,1px)] underline-offset-2 links-accent:underline-offset-4 links-default:decoration-primary/6 links-default:text-primary-subtle hover:links-default:text-primary-strong contrast-more:links-default:text-primary contrast-more:hover:links-default:text-primary-strong links-accent:decoration-primary-subtle hover:links-accent:decoration-[3px] hover:links-accent:[text-decoration-skip-ink:none] transition-all duration-100">https://security.snyk.io/<img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," class="gb-icon ml-0.5 inline size-3 links-accent:text-tint-subtle" /></a></span>, or you can incorporate database information into your own systems.

Snyk Vulnerability Database

The Snyk security team maintains the database to ensure that database remains consistently highly accurate, and eliminates false positives.

- <div class="text-base leading-normal mr-1 flex min-h-lh min-w-6 items-center justify-center text-tint">

  <div class="before:content-(--pseudoBefore--content) before:font-var" style="--pseudoBefore--content:'•';--font-family:Arial;font-size:min(1.5em, 24px);line-height:1">

  </div>

  </div>

  <div class="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col space-y-2">

  All items in the database are analyzed and verified.

  </div>

- <div class="text-base leading-normal mr-1 flex min-h-lh min-w-6 items-center justify-center text-tint">

  <div class="before:content-(--pseudoBefore--content) before:font-var" style="--pseudoBefore--content:'•';--font-family:Arial;font-size:min(1.5em, 24px);line-height:1">

  </div>

  </div>

  <div class="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col space-y-2">

  The team also invests in proprietary research to discover new vulnerabilities. You can consult the <span id="base-ui-_R_3tkbl59bsnqj6iv5ubsnpfivb_"><a href="https://security.snyk.io/disclosed-vulnerabilities" class="underline decoration-[max(0.07em,1px)] underline-offset-2 links-accent:underline-offset-4 links-default:decoration-primary/6 links-default:text-primary-subtle hover:links-default:text-primary-strong contrast-more:links-default:text-primary contrast-more:hover:links-default:text-primary-strong links-accent:decoration-primary-subtle hover:links-accent:decoration-[3px] hover:links-accent:[text-decoration-skip-ink:none] transition-all duration-100">disclosed vulnerability list<img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," class="gb-icon ml-0.5 inline size-3 links-accent:text-tint-subtle" /></a></span> to see all discovered vulnerabilities, by both first-party and third-party research.

#### <span class="pointer-fine:flex-1 z-1 justify-self-start max-w-full break-words page-cover-background:text-contrast-cover text-start self-start justify-start leading-snug" cover-aware-text="">Interval notation and semantic versioning</span><span class="hash inline-grid grid-area-1-1 pointer-fine:h-[1em] border-0 opacity-0 pointer-events-none site-background rounded transition-opacity pointer-fine:pointer-events-auto pointer-fine:group-hover/hash:opacity-100 pointer-fine:group-focus-within/hash:opacity-100 [.hash-revealed_&]:opacity-100 [.hash-revealed_&]:pointer-events-auto absolute [transform:translateY(0.17em)] pointer-fine:-ml-6 pointer-fine:relative pointer-fine:order-first pointer-fine:self-center pointer-fine:pr-2 pointer-fine:[transform:none] pointer-fine:[.flip-heading-hash_&]:order-last pointer-fine:[.flip-heading-hash_&]:ml-1 pointer-fine:[.flip-heading-hash_&]:pl-2"><a href="#interval-notation-and-semantic-versioning" class="inline-flex items-center p-1 pointer-fine:h-full pointer-fine:p-0 leading-snug" aria-label="Direct link to heading"><img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," class="gb-icon self-center transition-colors text-transparent pointer-fine:group-hover/hash:text-tint-subtle contrast-more:pointer-fine:group-hover/hash:text-tint-strong pointer-fine:group-focus-within/hash:text-tint-subtle contrast-more:pointer-fine:group-focus-within/hash:text-tint-strong [.hash-revealed_&amp;]:text-tint-subtle contrast-more:[.hash-revealed_&amp;]:text-tint-strong size-4" /></a></span>

The Snyk Vulnerability Database uses interval notation to express <span id="base-ui-_R_3sdl59bsnqj6iv5ubsnpfivb_"><a href="https://semver.org/" class="underline decoration-[max(0.07em,1px)] underline-offset-2 links-accent:underline-offset-4 links-default:decoration-primary/6 links-default:text-primary-subtle hover:links-default:text-primary-strong contrast-more:links-default:text-primary contrast-more:hover:links-default:text-primary-strong links-accent:decoration-primary-subtle hover:links-accent:decoration-[3px] hover:links-accent:[text-decoration-skip-ink:none] transition-all duration-100">semantic versioning<img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," class="gb-icon ml-0.5 inline size-3 links-accent:text-tint-subtle" /></a></span> across the many supported ecosystems.

You can check the interval notation for all vulnerabilities listed in the Snyk Vulnerabilities Database. Several different interval notations are supported by the Snyk Vulnerability Database:

- <div class="text-base leading-normal mr-1 flex min-h-lh min-w-6 items-center justify-center text-tint">

  <div class="before:content-(--pseudoBefore--content) before:font-var" style="--pseudoBefore--content:'•';--font-family:Arial;font-size:min(1.5em, 24px);line-height:1">

  </div>

  </div>

  <div class="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col space-y-2">

  Open interval notation - This does not include any limit points and uses `()` parenthesis for the notation.

  </div>

#### <span class="pointer-fine:flex-1 z-1 justify-self-start max-w-full break-words page-cover-background:text-contrast-cover text-start self-start justify-start leading-snug" cover-aware-text="">Vulnerability sources</span><span class="hash inline-grid grid-area-1-1 pointer-fine:h-[1em] border-0 opacity-0 pointer-events-none site-background rounded transition-opacity pointer-fine:pointer-events-auto pointer-fine:group-hover/hash:opacity-100 pointer-fine:group-focus-within/hash:opacity-100 [.hash-revealed_&]:opacity-100 [.hash-revealed_&]:pointer-events-auto absolute [transform:translateY(0.17em)] pointer-fine:-ml-6 pointer-fine:relative pointer-fine:order-first pointer-fine:self-center pointer-fine:pr-2 pointer-fine:[transform:none] pointer-fine:[.flip-heading-hash_&]:order-last pointer-fine:[.flip-heading-hash_&]:ml-1 pointer-fine:[.flip-heading-hash_&]:pl-2"><a href="#vulnerability-sources" class="inline-flex items-center p-1 pointer-fine:h-full pointer-fine:p-0 leading-snug" aria-label="Direct link to heading"><img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," class="gb-icon self-center transition-colors text-transparent pointer-fine:group-hover/hash:text-tint-subtle contrast-more:pointer-fine:group-hover/hash:text-tint-strong pointer-fine:group-focus-within/hash:text-tint-subtle contrast-more:pointer-fine:group-focus-within/hash:text-tint-strong [.hash-revealed_&amp;]:text-tint-subtle contrast-more:[.hash-revealed_&amp;]:text-tint-strong size-4" /></a></span>

Most of the vulnerabilities in the Snyk database originate from one of these sources:

1.  <div class="text-base leading-normal mr-1 flex min-h-lh min-w-6 items-center justify-center text-tint">

    <div class="before:content-(--pseudoBefore--content) before:font-var" style="--pseudoBefore--content:'1.';--font-family:inherit;font-size:min(1em, 24px)">

    </div>

    </div>

    <div class="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col space-y-2">

    Monitoring other vulnerability databases, such as CVEs from <span id="base-ui-_R_7r2nl59bsnqj6iv5ubsnpfivb_"><a href="https://nvd.nist.gov" class="underline decoration-[max(0.07em,1px)] underline-offset-2 links-accent:underline-offset-4 links-default:decoration-primary/6 links-default:text-primary-subtle hover:links-default:text-primary-strong contrast-more:links-default:text-primary contrast-more:hover:links-default:text-primary-strong links-accent:decoration-primary-subtle hover:links-accent:decoration-[3px] hover:links-accent:[text-decoration-skip-ink:none] transition-all duration-100">NVD<img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," class="gb-icon ml-0.5 inline size-3 links-accent:text-tint-subtle" /></a></span> and many others.

    </div>

2.  <div class="text-base leading-normal mr-1 flex min-h-lh min-w-6 items-center justify-center text-tint">

    <div class="before:content-(--pseudoBefore--content) before:font-var" style="--pseudoBefore--content:'2.';--font-family:inherit;font-size:min(1em, 24px)">

    </div>

    </div>

    <div class="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col space-y-2">

    Monitoring user activity on GitHub, including issues, PRs, and commit messages that may indicate a vulnerability.

    </div>

3.  <div class="text-base leading-normal mr-1 flex min-h-lh min-w-6 items-center justify-center text-tint">

    <div class="before:content-(--pseudoBefore--content) before:font-var" style="--pseudoBefore--content:'3.';--font-family:inherit;font-size:min(1em, 24px)">

    </div>

    </div>

    <div class="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col space-y-2">

    Bulk research, using tools that look for repeated security mistakes across open-source package code.

    </div>

4.  <div class="text-base leading-normal mr-1 flex min-h-lh min-w-6 items-center justify-center text-tint">

    <div class="before:content-(--pseudoBefore--content) before:font-var" style="--pseudoBefore--content:'4.';--font-family:inherit;font-size:min(1em, 24px)">

    </div>

    </div>

    <div class="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col space-y-2">

    Manual research, done by the Snyk Security team to manually audit more widely used packages for security flaws.

    </div>

For every issue deemed to be a real vulnerability, Snyk assigns the correct CVSS (severity) score and package version specification, creates an advisory, and makes this issue available to Snyk products for your use.

### <span class="pointer-fine:flex-1 z-1 justify-self-start max-w-full break-words page-cover-background:text-contrast-cover text-start self-start justify-start leading-snug" cover-aware-text=""><sup>Package Health Score</sup></span><span class="hash inline-grid grid-area-1-1 pointer-fine:h-[1em] border-0 opacity-0 pointer-events-none site-background rounded transition-opacity pointer-fine:pointer-events-auto pointer-fine:group-hover/hash:opacity-100 pointer-fine:group-focus-within/hash:opacity-100 [.hash-revealed_&]:opacity-100 [.hash-revealed_&]:pointer-events-auto absolute [transform:translateY(0.17em)] pointer-fine:-ml-6 pointer-fine:relative pointer-fine:order-first pointer-fine:self-center pointer-fine:pr-2 pointer-fine:[transform:none] pointer-fine:[.flip-heading-hash_&]:order-last pointer-fine:[.flip-heading-hash_&]:ml-1 pointer-fine:[.flip-heading-hash_&]:pl-2"><a href="#package-health-score" class="inline-flex items-center p-1 pointer-fine:h-full pointer-fine:p-0 leading-snug" aria-label="Direct link to heading"><img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," class="gb-icon self-center transition-colors text-transparent pointer-fine:group-hover/hash:text-tint-subtle contrast-more:pointer-fine:group-hover/hash:text-tint-strong pointer-fine:group-focus-within/hash:text-tint-subtle contrast-more:pointer-fine:group-focus-within/hash:text-tint-strong [.hash-revealed_&amp;]:text-tint-subtle contrast-more:[.hash-revealed_&amp;]:text-tint-strong size-4" /></a></span>

Snyk package health score helps you understand the overall health and reliability of open source packages. It provides a rating between 0 and 100, with higher scores indicating healthier and more trustworthy packages.

The following table lists supported languages and the availability of package health insights for each, based on their associated ecosystems.

### <span class="pointer-fine:flex-1 z-1 justify-self-start max-w-full break-words page-cover-background:text-contrast-cover text-start self-start justify-start leading-snug" cover-aware-text="">Incorporating the Vulnerability Database into your systems</span><span class="hash inline-grid grid-area-1-1 pointer-fine:h-[1em] border-0 opacity-0 pointer-events-none site-background rounded transition-opacity pointer-fine:pointer-events-auto pointer-fine:group-hover/hash:opacity-100 pointer-fine:group-focus-within/hash:opacity-100 [.hash-revealed_&]:opacity-100 [.hash-revealed_&]:pointer-events-auto absolute [transform:translateY(0.17em)] pointer-fine:-ml-6 pointer-fine:relative pointer-fine:order-first pointer-fine:self-center pointer-fine:pr-2 pointer-fine:[transform:none] pointer-fine:[.flip-heading-hash_&]:order-last pointer-fine:[.flip-heading-hash_&]:ml-1 pointer-fine:[.flip-heading-hash_&]:pl-2"><a href="#incorporating-the-vulnerability-database-into-your-systems" class="inline-flex items-center p-1 pointer-fine:h-full pointer-fine:p-0 leading-snug" aria-label="Direct link to heading"><img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," class="gb-icon self-center transition-colors text-transparent pointer-fine:group-hover/hash:text-tint-subtle contrast-more:pointer-fine:group-hover/hash:text-tint-strong pointer-fine:group-focus-within/hash:text-tint-subtle contrast-more:pointer-fine:group-focus-within/hash:text-tint-strong [.hash-revealed_&amp;]:text-tint-subtle contrast-more:[.hash-revealed_&amp;]:text-tint-strong size-4" /></a></span>

Incorporating information into your own systems is useful for customers who already have their own security products. You can benefit from Snyk’s expertise and accumulated knowledge with access to this database. This gives your development teams access to trusted intelligence, allowing them to rapidly secure open source and container code.

The Snyk Vulnerability Database includes two feeds:

- <div class="text-base leading-normal mr-1 flex min-h-lh min-w-6 items-center justify-center text-tint">

  <div class="before:content-(--pseudoBefore--content) before:font-var" style="--pseudoBefore--content:'•';--font-family:Arial;font-size:min(1.5em, 24px);line-height:1">

  </div>

  </div>

  <div class="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col space-y-2">

  Application Feed: with manually-curated content and summaries, including code snippets where applicable.

  </div>

- <div class="text-base leading-normal mr-1 flex min-h-lh min-w-6 items-center justify-center text-tint">

  <div class="before:content-(--pseudoBefore--content) before:font-var" style="--pseudoBefore--content:'•';--font-family:Arial;font-size:min(1.5em, 24px);line-height:1">

  </div>

  </div>

  <div class="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col space-y-2">

  Operation System Feed: Linux vulnerabilities from all supported Linux distributions.

  </div>

These feeds are licensed separately as standalone products.

</div>

</div>

</div>
